To make coordination easier across your global team, we suggest rotating the meeting time so each region occasionally gets a friendly hour.

Suggested rotation (examples shown in local times):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / Tue 18:00 CET / Wed 02:00 SGT
- Week B (EMEA-friendly): Tue 18:00 PT / Wed 02:00 CET / Wed 10:00 SGT
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Wed 07:00 PT / Wed 15:00 CET / Wed 23:00 SGT

Proposed next steps:
1) Which rotation pattern would you prefer long-term? We can rotate weekly or on a two-week cadence.
2) For the immediate demo, do any of these concrete slots work for your team next week?
   - Wed Apr 6, 10:00 PT (US-friendly)
   - Thu Apr 7, 09:00 PT (slightly earlier US)
   - Tue Apr 5, 18:00 PT (EMEA-friendly)
3) Please confirm who from Acme should join the technical session (infra/ops/ML engineers).

Attached is a short agenda for the demo: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf.

If any of the above work, I can send a calendar invite and include Aditya + our solutions notes.

Thanks,
